draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.59, the 246th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 22nd of 22 at RB. He went 250th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 616 rushing yards in 2021, 21st of 22 RBs in his class with stats.
